title: Alli Rae Design & Build Space page: fill every block from her site

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-30: style the Alli Rae Space like her site and design system; follow the Space style system, fill the Space, link as many blocks as possible

detail: The Space page already wears the Designer kit's faces and ochre accent (Space style system, ADR-1728/1906); what was missing was content. The Space had no cover, logo, address, hours, services, FAQ or story, so its blocks were empty or hidden. scripts/seed-alli-rae-space-info.mts prints one guarded, re-runnable SQL transaction: address and contact in profileData, the eight services as offerings, the story, five FAQ rows, cover and logo from /sites/alli-rae, and a profileLayout showing About, Offerings, Team, FAQ, Contact and Find us online while hiding blocks with nothing behind them. Reviews stay empty on purpose: the three testimonials need real member authors. The theme fence is untouched.

verify.evidence: The seed prints the filled profile data, five FAQ rows and the layout. The SQL is applied by the owner (production write needs the owner click).
